item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed abstract painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Use a deep midnight blue and black ground, layered with restless strokes of electric cobalt, bruised violet, and sharp flashes of warm amber. Build dense, overlapping bands of dry brush, translucent washes, scraped pigment, and fine splatters, moving in irregular waves that gather into areas of pressure and then break apart. Let broad gestures collide with delicate, trembling marks; keep the rhythm uneven, with sudden contrasts between saturated density and wide, quiet passages of near-black. Make the space feel charged, unresolved, and alive, with color and texture carrying all expression. Purely nonrepresentational: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
